prompts.characters:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE 1536x1024 landscape character reference sheet for a children's reading comic. The attached rabbit comic is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its polished dimensional animated-storybook rendering, tactile surfaces, appealing expressions, warm cinematic lighting, rich jewel colors. Do not copy rabbit, forest or doors.
CRITICAL: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, pseudo-writing.
Plain warm ivory studio background, generously spaced two horizontal rows.
Top row: the same human girl MILA shown full-body front view, three-quarter view, and side profile, plus three face expression studies (curious, surprised, relieved). Mila is an 8-year-old girl, medium warm brown skin, large brown eyes, short dark brown naturally curly bob, ONE small yellow star hair clip on her left, teal short-sleeve shirt under mustard-yellow short overalls, red sneakers with cream soles. Friendly contemporary child proportions, not a baby. Exactly same outfit and face in every view. Simple correct hands, five fingers when visible, two arms.
Bottom row: the same palm-sized baby dragon shown front, three-quarter and profile, plus three expressions curious, sneezing and peacefully asleep. Mint green smooth soft skin, pale cream belly, lavender inner bat wings, two tiny rounded warm-gold horns, two small external ears, brown expressive eyes, four limbs and one tail, friendly round snout. Beside these, clearly isolated prop studies of one cobalt blue fabric backpack with red zipper and a front pocket (NO marking), ONE simple yellow craft feather, a small plain cream water bowl and a wooden craft cup. The dragon is small enough to curl up in the backpack. No speech balloons on this sheet. Beautiful coherent production model sheet, consistent anatomy and proportions.
prompts.page01:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE finished children's comic page, EXACT canvas 1536x1024 landscape 3:2. Reference image 1 is the character/prop identity sheet: reproduce Mila, the tiny green dragon, blue backpack, yellow feather exactly. Reference image 2 is the intended polished dimensional storybook comic style; use it for rendering quality, cinematic lighting and cream empty narration boxes, NOT for story content.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE, NO letters, digits, symbols imitating writing, sound effect lettering, page numbers, captions, labels, title, logos or watermarks. All narration boxes must be COMPLETELY BLANK CREAM. No app interface or tablet.
LAYOUT: exactly THREE narrative panels: top left rectangular panel x0-768 y0-510, top right panel x768-1536 y0-510, bottom full-width panel x0-1536 y510-1024. Clean white gutters with thin dark navy outlines. Reading order left to right then down. Exactly ONE generous blank horizontal cream rounded rectangle with dark navy border at the TOP of each panel. Top left box approx x30 y22 width700 height160; top right box x804 y22 width700 height160; bottom panel box x35 y530 width1466 height155. Keep all art action and faces beneath these blank areas. The empty boxes are intentional spaces for live app text, never fill them.
CONTINUITY: same cozy child's bedroom in all panels, warm early-morning sunlight through ONE round wooden window, light wooden floor, soft violet oval rug, simple wooden craft desk at back, muted teal wall, plants. No posters, books with visible text, labels or markings.
PANEL 1 top left: Mila kneels beside a CLOSED cobalt-blue backpack with red zipper resting on violet rug, leaning her head toward it curiously because it is wobbling slightly. Tiny yellow craft feather pokes from its front pocket. Dragon is still hidden; do NOT show dragon here. Show Mila waist-up enough for face and bag, curly bob, star clip, teal shirt, mustard overalls.
PANEL 2 top right: same Mila has opened the main compartment. A tiny mint-green baby dragon with cream belly, lavender wing membranes and two small gold horns peeks its HEAD AND FOREPAWS from the backpack. Mila's face shows surprised delight. Feather remains in front pocket. Dragon palm-sized and clearly much smaller than backpack.
PANEL 3 bottom wide: dragon now sits on rug immediately beside the open backpack, sneezing a few iridescent round SOAPLIKE BUBBLES from its nose, one front paw gently near its snout. Mila sits beside it on the right, smiling then noticing its nose. Feather still protrudes from front pocket close to dragon, visually readable, but do not turn it into a second creature. No flame, no smoke, no water bowl yet. The same backpack, no extra backpack.
High-end animated-storybook finish matching reference; beautiful tactile hair and fabric, lovely eyes, subtle textured shading, warm amber and rich teal. Anatomically coherent, no duplicated limbs or fingers. Exactly three panels and exactly three empty boxes.
